title: Consultor Basis
description:
Consultor SAP Basis Sênior

Data de Início: Imediata

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: UK Time (10 AM – 19 PM)


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Administrar e gerenciar o ambiente SAP, incluindo instalação, configuração, monitoramento e manutenção de sistemas SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, PI/PO, etc.).

• Realizar atualizações, migrações e patches em sistemas SAP.

• Gerenciar a configuração e administração de usuários, segurança, perfis e autorizações.

• Planejar e executar tarefas de backup, recuperação de desastres e garantir a continuidade dos negócios.

• Realizar monitoramento de desempenho, análise e ajuste fino dos sistemas SAP.

• Colaborar com equipes de projeto para implementar soluções SAP em ambientes de desenvolvimento, teste e produção.

• Suporte a auditorias de segurança e conformidade, garantindo que as práticas recomendadas sejam seguidas.

• Prover suporte técnico de alta qualidade para a equipe interna e stakeholders.

• Documentar procedimentos e melhores práticas para a operação e administração dos sistemas SAP.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência mínima de 10 anos como Consultor SAP Basis, com histórico comprovado em ambientes complexos.

• Proficiência em instalação, atualização e administração de diferentes componentes do SAP (ABAP, JAVA, NetWeaver, HANA, etc.).

• Suporte e administração de bases de dados SAP HANA, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, Sybase ASE, incluindo a execução de tuning de performance e troubleshooting.

• Configuração e gerenciamento de clusters de alta disponibilidade e soluções de failover em ambientes SAP.

• Experiência com SAP Solution Manager.

• Experiência em administração de ambientes SAP em cloud, como AWS, Azure, ou Google Cloud Platform.

• Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais, como Linux, Windows e UNIX.

• Experiência com integração de SAP com Active Directory, Single Sign-On (SSO) e outras soluções de segurança.

• Forte compreensão de infraestrutura de TI, incluindo redes, servidores e storage.

• Habilidades em resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.

• Certificação SAP Basis e/ou SAP HANA será um diferencial.

• Inglês fluente, tanto escrito quanto falado.

• Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e organização.

• Orientado a detalhes com forte habilidade analítica.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: UK Time (10 AM – 19 PM)


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Administrar e gerenciar o ambiente SAP, incluindo instalação, configuração, monitoramento e manutenção de sistemas SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, PI/PO, etc.).

• Realizar atualizações, migrações e patches em sistemas SAP.

• Gerenciar a configuração e administração de usuários, segurança, perfis e autorizações.

• Planejar e executar tarefas de backup, recuperação de desastres e garantir a continuidade dos negócios.

• Realizar monitoramento de desempenho, análise e ajuste fino dos sistemas SAP.

• Colaborar com equipes de projeto para implementar soluções SAP em ambientes de desenvolvimento, teste e produção.

• Suporte a auditorias de segurança e conformidade, garantindo que as práticas recomendadas sejam seguidas.

• Prover suporte técnico de alta qualidade para a equipe interna e stakeholders.

• Documentar procedimentos e melhores práticas para a operação e administração dos sistemas SAP.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência mínima de 10 anos como Consultor SAP Basis, com histórico comprovado em ambientes complexos.

• Proficiência em instalação, atualização e administração de diferentes componentes do SAP (ABAP, JAVA, NetWeaver, HANA, etc.).

• Suporte e administração de bases de dados SAP HANA, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, Sybase ASE, incluindo a execução de tuning de performance e troubleshooting.

• Configuração e gerenciamento de clusters de alta disponibilidade e soluções de failover em ambientes SAP.

• Experiência com SAP Solution Manager.

• Experiência em administração de ambientes SAP em cloud, como AWS, Azure, ou Google Cloud Platform.

• Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais, como Linux, Windows e UNIX.

• Experiência com integração de SAP com Active Directory, Single Sign-On (SSO) e outras soluções de segurança.

• Forte compreensão de infraestrutura de TI, incluindo redes, servidores e storage.

• Habilidades em resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.

• Certificação SAP Basis e/ou SAP HANA será um diferencial.

• Inglês fluente, tanto escrito quanto falado.

• Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e organização.

• Orientado a detalhes com forte habilidade analítica.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON: ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior
description:
A aquarela está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior apaixonado(a) por criar soluções web ponta a ponta. Nesse papel, você atuará tanto no front-end quanto no back-end de projetos inovadores, utilizando tecnologias modernas (TypeScript/JavaScript – React, Next.js, Node.js – e Python) para impulsionar nossas soluções de IA e Analytics em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo.


Requisitos:


  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento fullstack , atuando no front-end (React, Next.js) e back-end de aplicações web
  • Domínio de JavaScript/TypeScript e padrões de projeto, com forte conhecimento em React e Next.js no front-end
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços backend (utilizando Node.js e/ou Python ), incluindo integração com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de software escalável, consumo de APIs RESTful/GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git )
  • Compromisso com qualidade: escrever código limpo, bem documentado, coberto por testes automatizados e aderente a práticas de CI/CD
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação técnica e comunicação no dia a dia de trabalho


Responsabilidades:
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web completas, abrangendo desde interfaces de usuário em React/Next.js até APIs e lógicas de negócio no backend
  • Projetar arquiteturas de software escaláveis e seguras, garantindo alta performance, qualidade e manutenibilidade dos sistemas
  • Implementar e promover boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo código limpo, testes unitários/integração, code reviews e integração/entrega contínua
  • Colaborar de forma próxima com times multidisciplinares (Produto, Design, Data Science) para definir requisitos, propor soluções técnicas e entregar novas funcionalidades de alto valor
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, atuando como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e contribuindo para o crescimento do time
  • Identificar e resolver problemas complexos de software, realizando depuração avançada e otimização de performance tanto no front-end quanto no backend, assegurando excelente experiência do usuário

    • Diferenciais:
    • Vivência com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD (integração contínua/entrega contínua), facilitando deploys ágeis e seguros
    • Experiência com serviços de computação em nuvem (AWS) e ferramentas de containerização/deploy (como Coolify ou Docker/Kubernetes)
    • Contribuições em projetos open source ou participação ativa em comunidades tech (meetups, conferências), demonstrando iniciativa e paixão pela área
    • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas
    • Cultura focada em inovação, colaboração e respeito mútuo – buscamos profissionais que se identifiquem com esses valores e que tenham perfil proativo , com vontade de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento continuamente

    • Modelo de trabalho:
    • Local de trabalho: modelo híbrido para profissionais em Salvador (BA) ou Florianópolis (SC) ; possibilidade de trabalho remoto para as demais regiões do Brasil
    • Regime de contratação: PJ ou CLT , à escolha do candidato, conforme sua preferência
    • Benefícios: pacote de benefícios negociável , de acordo com as necessidades do profissional (a ser discutido durante a proposta)
    • Remuneração: faixa salarial em aberto , negociada conforme a experiência e pretensões do candidato (oferecemos remuneração competitiva)
    • Horário: flexibilidade de horário com foco em entrega de resultados e qualidade do trabalho

    • Como se candidatar:

    Interessados(as) devem enviar currículo atualizado e, se possível, link do portfólio/projetos (GitHub, LinkedIn ou similares) para o e-mail , com o assunto "Vaga Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior - (Seu Nome)" . Estamos animados para conhecer seu talento!

title: Analista de aEEG / EEG
description:
Quem somos: A PBSF é uma instituição que une tecnologia e inteligência artificial para fazer a monitorização cerebral 24x7, com aplicação de metodologias capazes de prover diagnóstico precoce e neuroproteção em recém-nascidos de alto risco. Uma empresa brasileira, formada por médicos neonatologistas, a PBSF é respeitada mundialmente, possuindo parcerias internacionais com a Microsoft, Universidade de Stanford, Colégio Imperial de Londres, entre outros. No Brasil, sua rede de parceiros é composta por maternidades privadas, ranqueadas entre os melhores hospitais do mundo e por importantes unidades do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).


Descrição do Cargo:

Estamos à procura de um Folguista de Analista de aEEG / EEG que será responsável pela triagem dos exames em tempo real, e prestará suporte técnico remoto para o time de enfermagem que realiza a instalação do exame a beira leito.


Requisitos:

- Técnico em Enfermagem concluído.

- Desejável experiência em UTI Neonatal e/ou em Eletroencefalograma

- Noções de Informática


Escala de trabalho:

- Escala 12x36 (Folguista) - home office aos finais de semana e feriados (quando coincidir com a escala)

- Treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.


Forma de contratação: CLT - escala 12x36 (Folguista)

title: Video Editor - Direct Response
description:
We’re hiring a Video Editor with proven experience in direct response. You may specialize in short-form ads, long-form Video Sales Letters (VSLs), or both.


You’ll collaborate with our creative team to produce performance-driven videos that engage audiences and convert.


What You’ll Do:


Edit impactful short-form ads and/or long-form VSLs aligned to our direct-response strategy.


Collaborate with copy, design, and media buying to develop concepts that test well and scale.


Maintain brand and messaging consistency across deliverables.


Manage timelines, communicate progress, and deliver files ready for launch.


What You Bring:


Demonstrated success editing for e-commerce or direct-response brands.


Strong reel/portfolio and links to your 3 best VSLs (if you specialize in VSLs).


Speed, reliability, and attention to detail under tight deadlines.


Clear, proactive communication and collaborative mindset.


Familiarity with hooks, pattern interrupts, A/B iteration, and creative testing.


What to Submit:


Portfolio/reel (include platform context where possible).


Links to 3 best VSLs you’ve edited (if applicable).

title: Chatbot Developer Pleno
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Responsável por desenvolver e manter chatbots em diferentes plataformas, com foco em JavaScript e Python.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Manutenção Multi-Plataforma: Atuar na sustentação, troubleshooting e correção de bugs de chatbots desenvolvidos e implantados nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Evolução Rasa: Manter e evoluir a estrutura do framework Rasa, incluindo as custom actions, o deploy e, principalmente, os pipelines de NLU e as stories complexas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura Rasa: Gerenciar e manter o ambiente de deploy do bot em Rasa, garantindo o bom funcionamento e a estabilidade.
  • Integrações: Utilizar integrações de back-end (APIs, Webhooks) para o funcionamento dos fluxos em ambas as plataformas.
  • Qualidade Conversacional e Métricas: Trabalhar com a curadoria, refinando modelos de NLP/NLU. Além disso, definir e monitorar métricas de performance conversacional (ex: Intent Accuracy, Fallback Rate, Tempo de Resposta), propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Código e Padrões: Escrever e manter código limpo, testável e bem documentado, especialmente nas custom actions do Rasa (Python) e nos scripts do BLiP (JavaScript/Node.js).
  • Versionamento e CI/CD: Garantir o controle de versão com Git e auxiliar na manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD para automação do deploy do bot.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação técnica da arquitetura, integrações e procedimentos de manutenção.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e, principalmente, na sustentação (manutenção) de chatbots nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python e JavaScript/Node.js.
  • Domínio na utilização (consumo) de APIs REST/RESTful e Webhooks.
  • Conhecimento em NLP/NLU (treinamento, curadoria e fine-tuning de Intents e Entities).
  • Experiência com Git e familiaridade com conceitos de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática com Docker.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL).
  • Resolução de Problemas (Troubleshooting): Capacidade analítica para identificar, diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos em produção de forma eficaz.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum e/ou Kanban.


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:

  • Experiência com curadoria de dados conversacionais e otimização do dataset de treinamento.
  • Domínio na criação de APIs REST/RESTful do zero.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis) para armazenamento de contexto e dados conversacionais.
  • Familiaridade com orquestração de containers (ex: Kubernetes) para deploy de Rasa em escala.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering e integração de Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) em fluxos de chatbot.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) para hospedagem de serviços de apoio.


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Arquiteto/Tech Lead – Sistemas de Autorização (ISO 8583)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


O que esperamos que você realize:

Responsável por liderar a arquitetura, evolução técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos de autorização de transações financeiras, com foco em alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo a aderência aos padrões de mercado e a integração eficiente com sistemas de pagamento baseados no protocolo ISO 8583.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas de autorização financeira baseados em ISO 8583.
  • Liderar decisões técnicas e orientar o time no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Garantir a integração eficiente com terminais, adquirentes e emissores via mensagens ISO 8583.
  • Projetar e revisar modelos de dados em Oracle, otimizando consultas SQL e PL/SQL.
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de vida de aplicações em ambientes WebSphere e JBoss.
  • Promover a adoção de microserviços com Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Data e Security.
  • Estabelecer e manter pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps e infraestrutura em AWS.
  • Definir estratégias de conteinerização com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes.
  • Documentar e versionar APIs RESTful e SOAP com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Aplicar padrões de design e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Atuar como facilitador técnico em squads ágeis, promovendo colaboração e entrega contínua.

title: Data Engineer_ Snowflake
description:
Job Description: Senior Snowflake Data Engineer (Migration & Modelling)

Location: Brazil/ Costa Rica (Remote)

Job Type: Contract / Project-Based (Staff Augmentation)

Note : Need to support PST timings


Project Summary:

We are seeking highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineers to act as augmented members of a client's data team. You will be responsible for the hands-on execution of a complex, end-to-end data platform migration to Snowflake.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will be expected to integrate seamlessly with the existing team and take direct ownership of critical migration and data modelling tasks to accelerate the project's delivery. This is a complex transformation, not a simple "lift-and-shift."


Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Modelling & Architecture:
  • Collaborate with the client's BI and Data Science teams to define data requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models (e.g., Dimensional, Star Schema) optimized for Snowflake.
  • Develop and document data models, data definitions, and data flow diagrams for the new environment.
  • Data Migration & Engineering:
  • Execute the hands-on technical migration of data from legacy systems to the Snowflake Data Cloud
  • Engineer, build, and optimize robust ELT/ETL data pipelines within Snowflake (using SnowSQL, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, etc.).
  • Implement and automate data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
  • Team Integration & Delivery:
  • Integrate directly with the client's data team, participating in all relevant project routines and workflows.
  • Take ownership of assigned migration and modeling tasks, delivering high-quality, production-ready code and models with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to data migration, modeling, and pipeline performance.
  • Create clear technical documentation for all developed assets (models, pipelines, etc.).


Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Expert-level Snowflake: Deep, proven, hands-on experience with the Snowflake platform (architecture, SnowSQL, Snowpipe, performance optimization).
  • Expert-level Data Modeling: 4+ years of dedicated experience in data modeling (Dimensional, Relational) and data warehousing architecture.
  • Proven Data Migration: 4+ years of experience executing complex, large-scale data warehouse migrations (non-lift-and-shift).
  • Strong Data Engineering: Proficiency in building data pipelines (ELT/ETL) using SQL and modern tools (e.g., dbt, Python, or similar).
  • Execution Focus: A proven "do-er" with the ability to integrate into an existing team and deliver on complex technical tasks independently.
  • BI / Analytics Acumen: Strong understanding of how data models are consumed by BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) and Data Science workloads.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.

title: Estágio - Auxiliar Comercial & Administrativo
description:
Estágio – Auxiliar Comercial & Administrativo (100% Home Office) | Foco em Microsoft Planner e PPM

Tipo de vaga:  Estágio

Modelo:  100% Home Office

Carga horária:  30h semanais em horário comercial

Bolsa-auxílio:  R$ 1.712,98


Formação

Somente estudantes com previsão de formatura entre dez/2026 e dez/2027.

Cursos-alvo: Administração, Marketing, Relações Públicas e áreas correlatas.


Requisitos imprescindíveis

· Memória e organização para gerenciar múltiplas propostas e históricos de clientes.

· Pacote Office avançado (Word, Excel e Power Point)

· Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.

· Proatividade e atenção a detalhes.

· Condições para home office. Internet estável, ambiente silencioso, câmera e áudio funcionais.

· Inglês avançado.


Principais atividades

· Briefing pré-reunião: consolidar objetivos do cliente, histórico, materiais e próximos passos.

· Acompanhamento do funil comercial: do 1º contato e 1ª proposta até fechamento ou não do contrato, mantendo status e prazos atualizados.

· Gestão de propostas: versionamento, prazos, follow-ups, organização de arquivos.

· Apoio à diretoria: agendas, pautas, atas, resumos executivos.

· Organização no Microsoft 365: com foco em Planner e PPM no dia a dia.

· Planilhas e relatórios: pipeline, taxa de ganho, prazos de proposta.


Diferenciais

· Noções de CRM e cadência de follow-ups.

· Organização de documentos no SharePoint e OneDrive.


Boas práticas no remoto

· SLAs de resposta internos e com clientes.

· LGPD e confidencialidade no uso de documentos e comunicações.

· Padronização de nomes de arquivos e pastas.


Sobre a MLPro

Consultoria em Microsoft Planner e Microsoft PPM (Project Portfolio Management), também atuando com Power BI e Power Platform.

Buscamos alguém com memória afiada e organização rigorosa para apoiar diretamente a diretoria no processo comercial.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / Java / SQL)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience using Angular, Java, and SQL to develop analytics dashboard web applications for our industry-leading U.S. client. In this role, you will develop new capabilities in the client's core data product to support its e-commerce service.

Our client is an industry-leading, unified commerce and logistics provider that enables companies with omnichannel commerce capabilities, spanning product discovery to order fulfillment. The company's software, services, and logistics infrastructure serve many of the world's most popular brands, streamlining cross-channel operations and driving more efficient growth. With over 6,000 customers, our client revolutionizes the world of omnichannel commerce.


Responsibilities

  • Build solutions to find actionable insights from data and workflow to act on insights
  • Create APIs and UIs for a web-based analytics dashboard application
  • Deliver high-quality, architecturally sound, extensible code
  • Participate in the architecture, coding, and testing of developed systems
  • Assess requirements, discuss, and debate possible solutions
  • Troubleshoot to find and fix bugs
  • Write unit testing (TDD & BDD) and ensure good code coverage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software with SQL, Angular, and Java.
  • 3+ years of AWS or other cloud platform experience
  • Experience writing 500+ line analytics SQL queries
  • Extensive experience with Angular and Typescript
  • Experience with Node.js, especially the Nest.js framework
  • Built a data dashboard with dynamic tables and charts
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and with a team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • CI/CD experience with CircleCI, Jenkins, or similar technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js
  • Writing efficient SQL queries for big-data databases, such as Snowflake
  • Experience with container-based systems, such as Docker and AWS ECS
  • Experience with serverless computing, such as AWS Lambda
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and DevOps
  • Data management and analytics experience with dbt, FiveTran, and Looker
  • Experience with e-commerce data or analytics applications


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, learn and grow together!
  • Know your ideas are heard and matter!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with kind, smart, and creative people
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • 8 US holidays, PTO can be used for your local holiday
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Desenvolvedor IA
description:
Somos uma empresa do Grupo Stefanini. Especializados em marketing digital, utilizamos uma abordagem integrada que combina tecnologia, inteligência de dados, design e profundo conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor. Nosso foco está em potencializar os resultados de nossos parceiros, oferecendo soluções que vão desde consultoria estratégica até a execução e acompanhamento dos projetos. Com um time dedicado e altamente qualificado, a Gauge se destaca por sua capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e entregar resultados de alta performance.

Com forte presença na América Latina e em expansão nos Estados Unidos, estamos sempre na vanguarda, aplicando as últimas tendências de mercado e mantendo um olhar atento à inovação contínua.


DESENVOLVEDOR IA


Como Desenvolvedor Sr / Especialista de IA “Hands On”, você atuará em parceria com a equipe de desenvolvimento, não apenas liderando, mas também contribuindo ativamente para a codificação e implementação de soluções inovadoras. Sua experiência técnica e sua paixão pela IA serão essenciais para guiar o time na criação de soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho.



Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de software utilizando tecnologias de inteligência artificial.
  • Trabalhar com algoritmos e técnicas específicas de IA, incluindo NLP e aprendizado de máquina.
  • Implementar soluções de IA utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Utilizar frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain, para desenvolver soluções escaláveis.
  • Implementar soluções de NLP com ferramentas como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Realizar pré-processamento de texto, incluindo tokenização, criação de embeddings e remoção de stop words.
  • Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Porte (LLMs), como GPT e Llama, aplicando melhores práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver aplicações web utilizando frameworks como FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Colaborar na implementação de soluções utilizando MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para a implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Participar de processos de HAG (Hiper-Agilidade) para garantir entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Integrar e otimizar embeddings para melhorar a performance das soluções de IA.
  • Mentorizar e apoiar os membros da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado e colaboração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência com N8N é obrigatória.
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e otimização de embeddings.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de software para aplicações de inteligência artificial.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js ou Go.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain.
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de NLP, como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experiência em pré-processamento de texto e implementação de LLMs.
  • Vivência em arquiteturas de software escaláveis e de alto desempenho voltadas para IA.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web com FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Experiência com MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e boa comunicação.

DESENVOLVEDOR IA


Como Desenvolvedor Sr / Especialista de IA “Hands On”, você atuará em parceria com a equipe de desenvolvimento, não apenas liderando, mas também contribuindo ativamente para a codificação e implementação de soluções inovadoras. Sua experiência técnica e sua paixão pela IA serão essenciais para guiar o time na criação de soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho.



Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de software utilizando tecnologias de inteligência artificial.
  • Trabalhar com algoritmos e técnicas específicas de IA, incluindo NLP e aprendizado de máquina.
  • Implementar soluções de IA utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Utilizar frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain, para desenvolver soluções escaláveis.
  • Implementar soluções de NLP com ferramentas como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Realizar pré-processamento de texto, incluindo tokenização, criação de embeddings e remoção de stop words.

  • Experiência com frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain.

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web com FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Experiência com MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e boa comunicação.

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados SR

CLT, remoto e necessário inglês avançado.


Experiência recomendada: 5 a 7 anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento de aplicativos de BI


• Capacidade de identificar riscos técnicos e de segurança e propor ações de mitigação

• Experiência prática em Práticas de Gerenciamento de Configuração e Liberação

• Participar de modificações de software durante testes de integração

• Entender os requisitos das partes interessadas e documentá-los sob orientação

• Propor mudanças para melhorar a eficiência e/ou reduzir os custos de operação ou manutenção;

• Criar boas práticas e propor melhorias

• Reunir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, incluindo requisitos de segurança da informação, das partes interessadas e documentá-los



Habilidades Obrigatórias

• Azure Cloud: Proficiência em serviços de dados (Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Functions, Key Vault, etc.)

• Databricks: Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de pipelines, transformação de dados, notebooks (Python/Scala) e otimização do Spark

• CI/CD: Compreensão dos fluxos de trabalho de DevOps para implantação de pipelines (Azure DevOps, Git)

• Modelagem de Dados: Bom conhecimento dos conceitos de Data Lakehouse, Delta Lake, gerenciamento de esquemas e ajuste de desempenho

• DataOps: Experiência em gerenciamento de qualidade de dados, monitoramento de tarefas, registro e alertas

• Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas distribuídas, desempenho do Spark e formatos de dados (Parquet, Avro, JSON)

• Forte proficiência em Python e SQL

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role and Reponsabilities:

In this role you will have the chance to build large additions to our platform ecosystem, contributing to an infrastructure that centralizes our ETL and streaming infrastructure, enables experimentation and data development, and powers algorithm development. You will design and build scalable engineering solutions to solve business and data problems.


Core tech stack used by this role:

-S3 using Parquet and Iceberg for data storage

-Hive and Iceberg REST catalog as our metadata store

-Spark (Python, SQL, Scala) for data transformation

-Go, Scala and Java for backend development

-Kafka for data streaming

-Kubernetes and Helm for service deployments

-AWS IAM for access control

-Datadog for logging alerting and monitoring

-Trino as our federated query engine

-Identify, develop, and evangelize tooling, approaches, and data products that raise the bar of validity in experiment design and analyses across the company

-Collaborate with multiple teams and functions to deliver deep-dive analyses and experiment design for new initiatives and high-priority business areas

-Develop and iterate on our processes to empower more efficient and rigorous experimentation


Requirements

-You have a degree in an engineering or computer science field

-You have solid experience in platform engineering, with experience on experimentation platforms

-You have experience coding at a production level in Python, Go, Scala or Java

-You’ve built and supported RBAC systems used by enterprise-wide teams

-You have experience supporting Iceberg-based data warehouses



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Vendas
description:
Estamos buscamos alguém apaixonado por tecnologia e negócios para atuar como elo estratégico entre nossos clientes e nossa plataforma de automação financeira .


Se você tem perfil consultivo, gosta de transformar desafios em soluções e quer gerar impacto real em grandes empresas, essa vaga é para você! terá a missão de apoiar as áreas Comercial e de Sucesso do Cliente no desenvolvimento de oportunidades técnicas, funcionando como ponte estratégica entre o produto e os clientes. Atuará de forma consultiva em todas as etapas do ciclo de vendas, interpretando demandas de negócio e transformando-as em soluções técnicas. Sua atuação garantirá que a nossa plataforma gere valor concreto para instituições financeiras, fintechs e grandes empresas, especialmente em projetos de automação de conciliações financeiras e de integração com sistemas corporativos — como ERPs, processadores de pagamento e outras plataformas essenciais ao negócio.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Ser o braço direito dos executivos de contas em reuniões de pré-venda, conduzindo demonstrações técnicas, POCs e apresentações sobre arquitetura e segurança ;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes em temas de pagamentos, conciliação financeira, automação de processos e integração de sistemas;
  • Mapear requisitos, identificar riscos e propor alternativas técnicas antes do fechamento de cada contrato;
  • Criar propostas e documentações técnicas, garantindo clareza no escopo e alinhamento com os times de projeto;
  • Participar de kickoffs técnicos , assegurando que expectativa e entrega caminhem lado a lado;
  • Colaborar com Produto e Implantação, trazendo insights estratégicos a partir de tendências em meios de pagamento e integração financeira.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva em português e inglês ou espanhol;
  • Experiência em pré-vendas, vendas consultivas ou engenharia de soluções em softwares B2B;
  • Conhecimento sólido em pagamentos, core banking, orquestração ou automação financeira;
  • Capacidade de traduzir questões técnicas em propostas de valor para executivos de negócio;
  • Facilidade em conduzir apresentações técnicas, workshops e demos para grandes clientes;
  • Perfil consultivo, com habilidade de construir confiança e influência junto a líderes de tecnologia e finanças.


Diferenciais que vão brilhar no processo:

✨ Experiência com integração de APIs ou automação de data analytics;

✨ Passagem por fintechs, adquirentes, processadoras ou consultorias de tecnologia financeira.

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Vendas
description:
Estamos buscamos alguém apaixonado por tecnologia e negócios para atuar como elo estratégico entre nossos clientes e nossa plataforma de automação financeira .


Se você tem perfil consultivo, gosta de transformar desafios em soluções e quer gerar impacto real em grandes empresas, essa vaga é para você! terá a missão de apoiar as áreas Comercial e de Sucesso do Cliente no desenvolvimento de oportunidades técnicas, funcionando como ponte estratégica entre o produto e os clientes. Atuará de forma consultiva em todas as etapas do ciclo de vendas, interpretando demandas de negócio e transformando-as em soluções técnicas. Sua atuação garantirá que a nossa plataforma gere valor concreto para instituições financeiras, fintechs e grandes empresas, especialmente em projetos de automação de conciliações financeiras e de integração com sistemas corporativos — como ERPs, processadores de pagamento e outras plataformas essenciais ao negócio.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Oficial Quarto de Náutica
description:
Oficial Quarto de Náutica / 2nd Officer


Sobre a CBO:

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de Oficiais de Náutica (OQN) para atuar a bordo das embarcações da CBO, garantindo a condução segura, eficiente e em conformidade com os padrões internacionais de navegação e segurança marítima.


O profissional será responsável por apoiar as operações de navegação, manobra, posicionamento dinâmico e segurança da embarcação, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência operacional e para os resultados da companhia.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como Oficial de Quarto de Navegação/2nd Officer , monitorando rota, derrota e sistemas de navegação;


  • Apoiar o Comandante nas manobras e operações de posicionamento dinâmico (DP );


  • Planejar e executar a navegação conforme normas nacionais e internacionais (IMO, ISM, ISPS, RIPEAM,STCW );


  • Supervisionar atividades de convés e garantir a aplicação das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SMS / QSMS);


  • Executar as rotinas de segurança e salvatagem garantindo a aplicação das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SMS / QSMS);


  • Participar ativamente da rotina de bordo, mantendo disciplina operacional e foco em segurança;


  • Zelar pela manutenção e correta utilização dos equipamentos de navegação.



Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação em Ciências Náuticas (EFOMM, CIAGA ou CIABA, ASON ou ACON) ;
  • CIR ativa e certificados STCW válidos ;
  • Conhecimento em ISM, ISPS e normas da Autoridade Marítima Brasileira ;
  • Certificação DP Basic;

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Rio Grande do Sul
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

As an AI Developer at Pipefy, your mission is to leverage AI to solve user problems proactively! It can be programming a new feature, polishing existing features, supporting a team member, giving feedback, or solving a bug. Your role is crucial in driving our AI capabilities forward.


You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.


Since we are fully remote, you'll meet and work with people from all around the world.


One paragraph resume about what people can expect from working in this position (Mission in the role, responsibilities, seniority and what profile we are looking for).


Main Responsibilities:


- Develop new features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance, as well as improve existing ones, focusing on AI-driven functionalities.

- Take responsibility for the system quality by driving testability together with architects and QAs to ensure that the way we design our platform enables controllability and automation.

- Take responsibility for system stability, ensuring proper testing and observability, actively monitoring production behavior, and reacting quickly to incidents.

- Share knowledge with the team and learn together. We believe knowledge is much more valuable when shared, so we’re always learning and teaching each other.

- Take part in the continuous improvement of Engineering processes, like recruiting, hiring, onboarding, documentation, incidents, tech talks, etc.

- Sought out for technical guidance on your squad and related ones, anticipate technical issues at the product level, and make architectural and design decisions to avoid them.

- Consistently reduce the complexity of projects, systems, and processes to get more done with less work. Breaks up deliverables to optimize for earlier feedback and incremental delivery of business value.

- Help the team develop a more robust engineering culture focused on quality and impactful deliveries by setting an example and mentorship.

- Identify and proactively create projects to fix Pipefy's architecture when preconditions change and current architecture is not optimal/fit anymore, extracting and documenting platforms whenever necessary.


Requirements:


- Write correct, clean code with periodic guidance; consistently follows best practices, including tests (unit, functional, integration).

- Exceptional proficiency in Python, LLM applications and AI model integration.

- Design and develop code to provide an integrated and managed development life cycle for traditional and generative ML applications.

- Experience using LLM-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and others.

- Experience in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and working with vector databases.

- Have practical knowledge about infrastructure, service architectures, tools, libraries, frameworks, continuous integration, and continuous deployment systems.

- Able to seamlessly learn and guide others across large sections of our codebase.

- Actively contributes to the technical design of features.

- Understand and make well-reasoned design tradeoffs in their area.

- Strong ability with RESTful.


Bonus point:


- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs.

- Infrastructure: Cloud Computing, AWS, Networks, Load Balancers, Web Servers, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Monitoring.

- Experience with document processing and data extraction pipelines.

- Experience with GraphQL apis.

- You have a sharp eye for UX/UI, and you work user-centered.

- Experience with different types of methodologies and tools for Unit, Integration and End to End testing.

- Have good communication in oral and written English.

- Experience working on agile and lean methodologies.

- Experience building and scaling complex, high-performance, high-transaction applications.

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference
